learning_outcomes.text: Adequate knowledge of mathematics, science and related engineering discipline-specific subjects; Ability to use theoretical and applied knowledge in these fields in complex engineering problems.
Ability to define, formulate and solve complex engineering problems; the ability to select and apply appropriate analysis and modeling methods for this purpose.

The ability to select and use modern techniques and tools necessary for the analysis and solution of complex problems encountered in engineering applications; Ability to use information technologies effectively.
Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing; knowledge of at least one foreign language; writing effective reports and understanding written reports.
Awareness of the necessity of lifelong learning; ability to access information, follow developments in science and technology and constantly renew oneself.
Acting in accordance with ethical principles, knowledge about professional and ethical responsibility
Awareness about entrepreneurship and innovation; Information about sustainable development.
Information about the effects of engineering practices on health, environment and security at universal and social dimensions and the problems of the age reflected in the field of engineering.
Awareness of the legal consequences of engineering solutions.

syllabus_topics: Completing the knowledge gaps in theoretical foundations
Researching literature studies on the subject
Presentation of an original project proposal in terms of literature, where feasible methods and achievable success criteria are determined.
Presentation of an original project proposal in terms of literature, in which the feasible method and achievable success criteria are determined, Report writing.
